Alarms.AlarmDescription: The ticket provider (Jira) failed the 5-minute probe 3 times in a row, or the probe stopped reporting. report_completion is queueing ticket writes on agentcore-hub-ticket-replay.fifo - see deploy/ticket-provider-probe/README.md.

The ticket-provider replay DROPPED a queued completion because Jira refused one of its writes permanently (4xx). The ticket was not closed by the replay - a human must close it. The ticket comment and the workflow.ticket_replay_dropped journey event name it; the completion record in S3 is the source of truth. See deploy/ticket-provider-probe/README.md.
